scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic Z[u]-unimodular reductions and independent numerical integral Smith forms support the theorem. All computations and their dependencies are included; finite checks are explicitly distinguished from the uniform symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: The six new groups are the rational points of the connected Picard torus for blowups with Frobenius acting through the five-point permutation subgroup of W(D5). Other signed classes, torus isomorphism types, and universal realization for small fields are not classified. The five-cycle case is known prior work. Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Seven integral rational-point groups of the quartic del Pezzo sixteen-curve boundary
